race.title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Handicap debutant SEA EAGLE gets the nod in a tricky event. Hamsiyann often comes good at this time of year, and he's feared most on return, while Belle The Tigress could have a say if ready to roll on the back of an absence. SEA EAGLE HAMSIYANN (IRE) BELLE THE TIGRESS (IRE)
